{{Otheruses|Squall}}
The '''''Squall''''' was a combat [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was assigned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Mar'ek]] received a transmission from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] while on the bridge of the ''Squall'', ordering the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] to execute the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency directive]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
